resources.string: Both devices must be on the same Wi-Fi network. While the app is open they find each other automatically; you can send a canvas or an image to a device.
Both devices must be on the same Wi-Fi network. When you start a broadcast, every change on the chosen canvas appears live on the other device.
Send canvases and images to devices on the same Wi-Fi (Android, iPhone, iPad)
When off, canvases and images from connected devices are received without asking
Broadcast a canvas live to devices on the same Wi-Fi or watch someone else\'s broadcast
When off, broadcasts started by connected devices are joined without asking
When off, a joined broadcast is opened from the card on the Live canvas broadcast page
Step-by-step drawing practices with simple drawing
You are editing the shape in advanced drawing mode. Tap Save to put everything on this canvas in place of the shape in your note; leave without saving to discard changes.
Broadcast paused: the sender is editing
Place the main subject on the lines and their crossings; not saved on the paper.
A small preview in the corner: see your drawing with fresh eyes and catch mistakes.
A horizontally flipped view makes proportion and symmetry errors stand out.
Check the balance of lights and darks without colour.
Send canvases to devices on the same Wi-Fi or broadcast drawing, note and comic canvases live. Settings are in the Connection tab.
